# Repository Instructions

## Purpose
The purpose of this repo is to provide training materials and resources for Agent Academy. Used by sopra steria employees. As our Tenant differs in some aspects the original training content may need to be adapted accordingly. You job is to help me make the necessary adjustments to ensure the content is accurate and relevant for our context.


## Language and Tone
Conversations with Kevin will be in dutch, anything else must be in English.

## Mission Writing

Whenever you create or edit Agent Academy instructional content, including instructions within missions, read and follow the root-level [WRITING_STYLE.md](../WRITING_STYLE.md). This applies to revisions as well as new content. Follow the general requirements and the section specific to the mission type; treat the guide as the source of truth for structure, voice, accessibility, formatting, and lab steps.

## Course Content Scope

For course-content changes, work only in `docs/recruit-nextgen/` and only on missions whose frontmatter has `harness: microsoft-copilot` (Microsoft Copilot Harness). Keep other tracks and non-Harness missions unchanged unless Kevin explicitly expands the scope.
